relic.jade_pendant.name: Jade Pendant
relic.jade_pendant.desc: +8 barrier points from Flowing Ward and Stone Aegis; you take 5% more damage while the jade wards burn.
relic.ember_bead.name: Ember Bead
relic.ember_bead.desc: Burn lasts 2 s longer on foes you ignite; the bead's heat never quite leaves your palm.
relic.river_pearl.name: River Pearl
relic.river_pearl.desc: Wet lasts 2 s longer where your arts land; techniques cost 5% more energy as the current drags at your casting.
relic.thunder_charm.name: Thunder Charm
relic.thunder_charm.desc: Conduct hits deal 20% more damage; the charm's edge shaves your guard — you take 5% more damage.
relic.mountain_token.name: Mountain Token
relic.mountain_token.desc: +20 max health while carried; the stone's weight slows your blade by 8% sword damage.
relic.verdant_seed.name: Verdant Seed
relic.verdant_seed.desc: Healing you receive is 15% stronger; the seedling draws on your qi — techniques cost 5% more energy.
